books.title: Tuesdays with Morrie
books.creator: Mitch Albom
books.blurb: Mitch Albom reconnects with his old sociology professor, Morrie Schwartz, and visits him every Tuesday as Schwartz is dying of ALS. Their talks become a last class on love, work, family, and how to live.

books.title: Autobiography of a Yogi
books.creator: Paramahansa Yogananda
books.blurb: Yogananda's account of his search for a guru in India, and the saints, scientists, and teachers he met along the way. Published in 1946, it was many Western readers' first introduction to yoga and meditation.

movies.title: The Martian
movies.creator: Ridley Scott
movies.blurb: During a manned mission to Mars, astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. He has survived, and must use his ingenuity to stay alive on the hostile planet.

movies.title: The Social Network
movies.creator: David Fincher
movies.blurb: In 2003, Harvard undergrad Mark Zuckerberg begins work on a new concept that becomes Facebook. His unprecedented success leads to personal and legal battles with the people who helped him get there.

movies.title: Good Will Hunting
movies.creator: Gus Van Sant
movies.blurb: Will Hunting is a headstrong, working-class genius who keeps failing the lessons of life. After one too many run-ins with the law, a psychology professor may be the only person who can reach him.

movies.title: Super 30
movies.creator: Vikas Bahl
movies.blurb: Based on the life of Patna mathematician Anand Kumar, who runs the Super 30 program for IIT aspirants who cannot afford coaching.

movies.title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
movies.creator: Imtiaz Ali
movies.blurb: Haunted by a childhood romance lost during the 1947 Partition, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal tells his grandson the story of migration, longing, and a love that endures across generations.

movies.title: Jacob's Kingdom of Heaven
movies.creator: Vineeth Sreenivasan
movies.blurb: Jacob, a successful businessman settled in Dubai with his family, is forced to flee when a friend's betrayal leaves him with a huge debt.

movies.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
movies.creator: Martin Scorsese
movies.blurb: A New York stockbroker refuses to cooperate in a large securities fraud case involving corruption on Wall Street, corporate banking, and mob infiltration. Based on Jordan Belfort's autobiography.

movies.title: Meet Joe Black
movies.creator: Martin Brest
movies.blurb: Days before his 65th birthday, successful Bill Parrish is visited by a mysterious stranger who reveals himself as Death. In exchange for extra time, Bill agrees to serve as Joe's earthly guide.

movies.title: Green Book
movies.creator: Peter Farrelly
movies.blurb: In 1962, bouncer Tony Lip is hired to drive pianist Don Shirley on a tour through the segregated Deep South, relying on a travelers' guide called The Negro Motorist Green Book.

movies.title: Moneyball
movies.creator: Bennett Miller
movies.blurb: Oakland Athletics general manager Billy Beane tries to build a winning baseball team on a budget by using computer-generated analysis to draft his players.

movies.title: Slumdog Millionaire
movies.creator: Danny Boyle
movies.notes: Would be an easy 5 if it wasn't for the heinous and incorrect representation of India
movies.blurb: A teenager reflects on his life after being accused of cheating on the Indian version of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?

movies.title: Beautiful Boy
movies.creator: Felix van Groeningen
movies.blurb: After he and his first wife separate, journalist David Sheff struggles to help their teenage son, who goes from experimenting with drugs to becoming addicted to methamphetamine.

movies.title: Dead Poets Society
movies.creator: Peter Weir
movies.blurb: At an elite New England boarding school, a passionate English teacher inspires his students to rebel against convention and seize the potential of every day.

movies.title: Ford v Ferrari
movies.creator: James Mangold
movies.blurb: American car designer Carroll Shelby and driver Ken Miles battle corporate interference and their own demons to build a race car for Ford and take on Ferrari at Le Mans.

movies.title: Sarvam Maya
movies.creator: Akhil Sathyan
movies.blurb: A man who loses his belief in God meets the spirit of a young woman who cannot remember what happened to her.

movies.title: 3 Idiots
movies.creator: Rajkumar Hirani
movies.blurb: From the moment he arrives at India's most prestigious university, Rancho's schemes turn the campus upside down, along with the lives of his two newfound best friends.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.creator: Destin Daniel Cretton
movies.blurb: Fighting crime as Spider-Man in a world that does not remember him, and watching old friends move on without him, sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control.

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.creator: Christopher Nolan
movies.blurb: Odysseus, the King of Ithaca, embarks on a long journey home after the Trojan War, confronting gods, monsters, and trials that stretch his cunning and his humanity.

movies.title: Nuremberg
movies.creator: James Vanderbilt
movies.blurb: In postwar Germany, an American psychiatrist must decide whether Nazi prisoners are fit to stand trial, and finds himself in a battle of intellect and ethics with Hermann Göring.
